scripts.build:preload: bun build src/preload/index.ts --outfile dist/preload.cjs --target node --format cjs --external electron
scripts.build: rm -rf dist && bun run build:preload --minify --production && bun run build:renderer --minify --production
scripts.start: bun run build && bun run app
scripts.dev: rm -rf dist && bun run --parallel watch:preload watch:renderer app
